 How Does Polymarket Work?
 Polymarket is a CFTC-regulated prediction market exchange, not a sportsbook. Users buy and sell Yes or No contracts on specific outcomes, which are priced between 1 and 99 cents. When an event concludes, these contracts settle at $1 if your prediction is correct and $0 if it is not.
 There is no house or bookmaker setting a line and taking the other side of your trade. Instead, traders transact peer-to-peer with each other, meaning active positions can usually be sold before an event resolves rather than being locked in until the final buzzer. This structure means that users have maximum flexibility until a game is done. The lack of a vig also means that users get a higher potential payout with Polymarket.
 Where Can You Trade With Polymarket?
 Users must be 18 or older and physically located in an eligible US state to trade on the platform. The platform is broadly accessible, but the fully excluded states are Arizona, Illinois, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, Montana, Nevada, Ohio, and Washington. Prediction markets remain the subject of ongoing legal and regulatory challenges at the state level, so the list of available states can change, and readers should always confirm their eligibility at sign-up.
 Why Polymarket Promo Code WTOP Is The Best Choice
 This offer stands out specifically for those looking to avoid an offer that requires initial trading volume. The $10 deposit reliably unlocks the $25 in bonuses. NBA fans can sign up with our code WTOP, complete that $10 deposit, and start trading on tonight’s slate with the $25 bonus before the first tip-off.
 Polymarket Promo Code WTOP: FAQ
 The following section answers the most common questions regarding Polymarket promo code WTOP and general platform eligibility.
 What is the Polymarket promo code?
 The promo code is WTOP. By entering this code during your initial registration, new Polymarket customers will trigger a deposit $10 at Polymarket and get $25 in bonuses welcome offer.
 How do you unlock the $25 Polymarket bonus?
 New Polymarket customers must fund their account with a first-time deposit of at least $10.
 Is Polymarket legal in my state?
 The exchange is legally accessible to participants 18 and older in every US state except Arizona, Illinois, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, Montana, Nevada, Ohio, and Washington. Since the regulatory environment for prediction markets is constantly shifting at the state level, jurisdictional availability can change, making it vital to confirm your eligibility during the sign-up process.
 Is Polymarket a sportsbook?
 No. Polymarket operates as a CFTC-regulated prediction market exchange where participants trade event-based contracts peer-to-peer. There is no house acting as a bookmaker to set odds or take the other side of your wagers, as all contract prices are determined entirely by user trading volume.
 Can the bonus be used on tonight’s NBA games?
 Yes. You can immediately deploy your $25 in bonuses on the October 23 NBA slate, and any other markets available on the app.
